# JLL CAPITAL MARKETS

## OFFERING MEMORANDUM

# Riverside Corporate Center
## 1100 Riverside Drive, Atlanta, GA 30339

Class A Office | Available for Acquisition

---

## THE OPPORTUNITY

JLL is pleased to present the opportunity to acquire Riverside Corporate Center, a Class A office building totaling 312,500 rentable square feet. The property was built in 2007 and is currently 88.2% occupied by a diverse roster of credit tenants.

## KEY METRICS

Net Operating Income: $6,240,000

Capitalization Rate: 7.25%

Occupancy: 88.2%

Year Built: 2007

The in-place Net Operating Income of $6,240,000 reflects a going-in capitalization rate of 7.25% at the guidance pricing.

---

## RENT ROLL SUMMARY

Tenant: Aldridge Partners LLC $48,500
Tenant: Vantage Logistics $32,750
Suite: 1200 $21,000

---

## TENANCY

The building benefits from a weighted average lease term of 6.4 years remaining. Total occupancy stands at 88.2% as of the most recent rent roll.

This Offering Memorandum has been prepared by JLL for use by a limited number of parties and does not purport to be all-inclusive.
